package.description: A focused SAP OData explorer for real systems, with catalog discovery, metadata browsing, and query tooling.

en-US.description: A focused SAP OData explorer for real systems, with catalog discovery, metadata browsing, and query tooling.
en-US.longDescription: Desktop explorer for SAP OData services: catalog discovery across V2/V4, metadata and annotation browsing with a Fiori-aware SAP view, query building and execution with an HTTP trace inspector, and an offline EDMX library for browsing hand-carried $metadata files without a network connection. Not affiliated with SAP SE.
en-US.name: SAP OData Explorer
